summary: The member who has been standing at the lectern finally sits while the clerk calls names.
realLife: Senate filibuster speakers used quorum calls for rest under rules requiring them to stand while speaking.
gates: A speaking filibuster is underway and a quorum call has begun.
inGame: The chamber records floor-debate and cloture shortfalls. needs: a quorum call and recognition of the next speaker.

turns.what: The clerk finds a quorum immediately and the speaker returns to the argument.
turns.pulledBy: Enough members are already on the floor.
turns.writesBack: The call buys almost no rest.

turns.what: A colleague takes up the argument after the roll.
turns.pulledBy: The first speaker needs a longer break and a colleague is ready.
turns.writesBack: The debate continues under the colleague's name.
